// Compiled only in the pinned epusdt test checkout by scripts/acceptance/gmpay.sh.
package mq

import (
	"encoding/pem"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/internal/testutil"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/model/dao"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/model/data"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/model/mdb"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/model/request"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/model/service"
	"github.com/GMWalletApp/epusdt/route"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
)

func TestPPanelMerchantInterop(t *testing.T) {
	defer testutil.SetupTestDatabases(t)()
	if err := dao.Mdb.Create(&mdb.WalletAddress{Network: mdb.NetworkTron, Address: "TTestTronAddress001", Status: mdb.TokenStatusEnable}).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	api := echo.New()
	route.RegisterRoute(api)
	// Feed one synthetic chain confirmation into the upstream production ledger.
	api.POST("/_fixture/confirm/:id", func(c echo.Context) error {
		id := c.Param("id")
		if err := service.OrderProcessing(&request.OrderProcessingRequest{TradeId: id, BlockTransactionId: "fixture-" + id}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return c.NoContent(200)
	})
	api.POST("/_fixture/notify/:id", func(c echo.Context) error {
		o, err := data.GetOrderInfoByTradeId(c.Param("id"))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if o.Status != mdb.StatusPaySuccess {
			return echo.NewHTTPError(409)
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "merchant.url"))
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		local, err := url.Parse(string(raw))
		if err != nil || local.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || local.Scheme != "http" {
			return echo.NewHTTPError(500)
		}
		target, err := url.Parse(o.NotifyUrl)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		// The worker sends its real signed payload to the local merchant handler.
		local.Path = target.Path
		o.NotifyUrl = local.String()
		if err := sendOrderCallback(o); err != nil {
			t.Logf("worker callback: %v", err)
			return err
		}
		return c.NoContent(http.StatusOK)
	})
	peer := httptest.NewTLSServer(api)
	defer peer.Close()
	viper.Set("app_uri", peer.URL)
	cert := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: peer.Certificate().Raw})
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(t.Context(), os.Getenv("PPANEL_ACCEPT_BIN"), "-test.run", "^TestLTSGMPayMerchant$", "-test.v")
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "PPANEL_ACCEPT_GMPAY_URL="+peer.URL, "PPANEL_ACCEPT_GMPAY_CA="+string(cert), "PPANEL_ACCEPT_DIR="+dir)
	cmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
	cmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
